sb.name: Sovereign Ooze Lord
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, grappled, incapacitated, prone, restrained, stunned
sb.languages: telepathy 120 ft., understands Common but can't speak

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ooze has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Merge
traits.desc: The ooze and one other Sovereign Ooze Lord within 5 feet of it merge over the course of a Short Rest. When both oozes finish the Short Rest, they merge into a Sovereign Ooze Monarch.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ooze makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Glob (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the ooze can see within 90 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: The ooze shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or smaller Humanoid or Beast while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

bonus_actions.name: Transformation (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the ooze can see within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points. Failure: The target dies. After one minute, the target transforms into a Sovereign Ooze Vassal, unless it is restored to life or the ooze is destroyed before a minute passes. Only a [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]] spell can reverse this transformation.

legendary_actions.name: Arcane Spray
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the ooze. Failure: 16 (3d10) Force damage. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The ooze can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Manipulate
legendary_actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature the ooze can see within 60 feet. Failure: 26 (4d12) Psychic damage, and if able, the target takes a Reaction to move up to its Speed in a horizontal direction of the ooze's choice, following the safest route. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The ooze can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Strike
legendary_actions.desc: The ooze moves up to its Speed and makes one Slam attack.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.
